package.name: fpc_test_dashboard
package.description: Forward-position-controller (FPC) capability test platform. A web dashboard used to characterise a new robot's position-passthrough behaviour before deploying host-side admittance / Cartesian force control on top of it. It reads the robot's joints from the URDF (/robot_description), lets the operator pick joints to test, then runs an automatic battery per joint -- smooth tracking, stair-stepped (low-rate teleop) tracking, and command-smoothed tracking -- driving the arm's ForwardCommandController and recording the actual joint motion (and the wrist wrench, if available) to plot the tracking quality, latency and vibration that admittance control will depend on.
